login.title: OIUEEI
login.magicLinkSent: If this email is registered, your magic link is on its way — check your inbox, and your spam folder just in case.
login.pitch: Share what you have with the people you trust — no ads, no strangers.
login.description: OIUEEI is an open-source app for sharing what you own with the people around you. Create a collection — things to give away, sell, rent or lend — and share it with your circle: they can browse, reserve and ask.
login.openSource: OIUEEI's code is public — source-available under BUSL 1.1, MIT from 2030. The project lives on <1>GitHub</1>: ideas, issues and collaboration are welcome there. New here? The Pop in button below is the door.
login.manifesto: No ads, no trackers. Your data is not the product.
login.noBanner: You won't see a cookie banner: there is nothing to consent to. No advertising, no analytics, no third-party code running in your browser — and you don't have to take my word for it, <1>you can check</1>.
login.loginHelp: Trouble signing in? Tell us and we'll try to help as soon as we can →

bulkAdd.heading: Add many at once (CSV)
bulkAdd.help: Add multiple things from a CSV — or a ZIP with the photos included.
bulkAdd.formatIntro: Upload a CSV with a "headline" column (required). Optional columns: type, description, fee, availability, location, condition, tags (separate multiple tags with |). To add photos, upload a ZIP with the CSV plus the image files and reference each photo by filename in a "photo" column.

localized.hint: Bilingual group? You can write one text per language.
localized.tagsHint: Tags can hold one label per language too.
localized.infoBody: If your group reads in two languages, write the title or the description as a small map — copy this and change the words. Everyone then reads it in their own language, in the app and in their emails.
localized.tagsInfoBody: A tag label works the same way — write it as a map and each member sees their own.
localized.infoFallback: Languages: es (Spanish), ca (Catalan), en (English). Write in one only if you prefer — anything that isn't a map is shown exactly as you typed it.

deleteAccount.intro: Deleting your account is immediate and irreversible once you confirm it. This page tells you exactly what goes and what stays.
deleteAccount.whatGoes: Your account, your collections, your things and their photos, and your pending requests — permanently.
deleteAccount.whatStays: Questions you asked on other people's things and the history of things that passed through your hands stay, without your name — shown as “Former member”.
deleteAccount.emailStep: To make sure it's really you, we'll email you a confirmation link. Nothing is deleted until you open it and confirm there.
deleteAccount.sentBody: We've sent you the confirmation link. It works for 24 hours. If you change your mind, simply ignore it — nothing will happen.
deleteAccount.error: We couldn't send the email. Please try again.
